items.name: theme
items.title: KOC Theme
items.description: Kuwait Oil Company brand tokens for light and dark. Anchored to #0060A9, recovered from KOC's own stylesheets. Install this first — it re-skins a stock shadcn app into a KOC app.

items.name: org
items.title: Org model
items.description: The KOC organisational model a team dashboard is configured from — Directorate › Group › Team › Unit. Adding a team dashboard is a TeamConfig, not a new component.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: Viewport hook backing the sidebar's mobile sheet behaviour.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn utility
items.description: Class merger — clsx + tailwind-merge.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline message. Callers must supply an icon — colour alone cannot carry severity.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: The standard KOC team dashboard frame. Configured entirely from a TeamConfig — unit switcher, unit nav and an always-visible team-wide zone. Building a dashboard for another team is a config file, not a fork.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: User image with initials fallback. Two letters is the most that stays legible at 32px.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Counts, tags and categories. `shape="count"` gives a circular count that becomes a pill past two digits. For plant state use @koc/status-badge instead.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Path within an app. Used by @koc/page-header.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Six variants, four sizes. Every label/background pair is contrast-tested.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Date and range picker built on react-day-picker.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: The primary surface for grouping dashboard content.

items.name: chart
items.title: Charts
items.description: TrendChart, ComparisonChart and VolumeChart. Series colour comes from the tested --chart-1..5 tokens in order, every chart carries a screen-reader text alternative, and the React 19 StrictMode fix is not a prop.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Binary control built on Base UI.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Show/hide a region. Backs nested sidebar navigation.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable single-select. shadcn documents this as a Command + Popover pattern rather than shipping it, which means every project assembles a slightly different one; this is the KOC version.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Filterable command list built on cmdk. Backs @koc/combobox.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: A decision that cannot be undone. Takes the subject as a required prop, so the question reads 'Void report BG-1042?' rather than 'Delete Item?' — a confirmation that does not name what it destroys is how people delete the wrong thing.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Sorting, filtering, column visibility and pagination on TanStack Table v9 — with loading, empty and filtered-empty as three distinct states, and numeric alignment declared on the column rather than remembered in a cell renderer.

items.name: date-range-filter
items.title: Date Range Filter
items.description: Presets first, calendar second. Today / 7 days / 30 days / This month are one click; the range picker is there for the exception.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal surface. Use for a record you read and return from, or a short focused form.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Action and option menus built on Base UI.

items.name: filter-tabs
items.title: Filter Tabs
items.description: A segmented control that filters a view, with a count on each option. Takes `renderPanel` rather than children, so it is not possible to build one whose tabs control nothing.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text field. Its border carries KOC's WCAG 1.4.11 compliance at 3.63:1 — do not soften it to border-border.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form label. Always pair with a control via htmlFor.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Horizontal menu primitive with dropdown panels. Backs @koc/page-nav.

items.name: notification-menu
items.title: Notification Menu
items.description: Operational alerts in the app header. The unread count is derived from the items rather than passed in, so the badge cannot disagree with the list — an unread count nobody can clear trains people to ignore it.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The top of every KOC application screen — title, optional breadcrumb, actions and meta. The title is an h1 because the app shell contributes no heading, so without it a screen has no top-level landmark at all.

items.name: page-nav
items.title: Page Nav
items.description: Horizontal navigation inside an application. The sidebar answers 'which app am I in'; this answers 'which part of this app'. One level of dropdown only — deeper than that and the screen wants a sidebar.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Non-modal floating panel. Backs the date picker and combobox.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Single-choice dropdown built on Base UI.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Visual divider. Always `role="separator"` — Base UI has no decorative mode, and a rule between sections legitimately is one.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Edge-anchored panel. Backs the sidebar's mobile behaviour.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible sidebar primitives with an icon rail, mobile sheet and keyboard shortcut. Diverges from upstream: collapsed padding is scoped per size, because upstream's base `p-2!` beats `lg`'s `p-0!` on CSS source order.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder. Prefer it over a spinner so layout does not jump when data lands.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toaster
items.description: Transient confirmation of an action the user just took. Mount once at the app root; call `toast` from anywhere.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: A KPI with a change indicator. Direction and sentiment are separate inputs, because at an oil company 'up' is not always good.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: Operational state for wells, assets and jobs. Takes a status, not a colour — it derives colour, icon and label together so WCAG 1.4.1 cannot be violated by omission.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table primitives. Body cells get tabular figures automatically; right-align numeric columns. For sorting, filtering and pagination use @koc/data-table.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between sibling views. Use for scope (assets, periods), not for filters.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short label on hover and focus. Load-bearing in a collapsed icon rail — it is the only accessible name those buttons have.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User Menu
items.description: Account menu. Groups render with separators between them; put sign out in its own group so it is not one pixel below Settings.
